text.text_excerpt: Holly is a really cool lady and as a bonus she also makes some kick-ass tamales. Holly's Tamales are usually found being sold out of Holly's purple tricycle that has a large food box on it from whence the delicious tamales are served. The tricycle can generally be found in the Bywater, Marigny and Quarter areas but sometimes special requests for other locations can be accomplished. Holly learned her tamale skills from her family and its a tradition that is several generations perfected now. I've had the noted Doe's Eat Place tamales along with many other tamales around the country and Holly's are the best I've had as they are the perfect mixture of meat and masa with optimal moistness tha...

Reasonably priced and delicious, Holly Tamale makes the best! Of what I recall, her family had been doing this so it was passed on to her. Also, Holly offers suggestions of what tamales she Should make next as well. Shes keen on social media so that's how you can basically offer suggestions that way.- just keep in mind on prices and if it's possible--- I'm sure if you suggested like a truffle fondue kale tuna tar tar, she'd smack you across the face. Her tamales are delicious, she a bonefide hustler. Treat her kindly.

Holly was like a rainbow brite beacon when she arrived at Daiquiri Fest this past weekend. I had heard tales of her epic tamales before, and had to try them. I was solo manning a table, and couldn't find the time to venture out to the food trucks outside. She rolls up in the perfect marriage of cycle and food cart, and it's purple...so I love it. Hungry daq goers flock to her...I fear she'll run out of tamales, but she keeps serving them up. I look about and find my chance to run over and check out what she's cookin' with.
